notes: One quarter loaf of 4. Assumptions: the whole 700 g loaf is served (the pulled-out plugs go back on top), ~465 kcal of bread a quarter; tinned sugar beans drained at 240 g a tin; all 3 tbsp oil eaten; Durban masala taken as chilli powder. Compared against: FatSecret ZA generic bunny chow at 529 kcal for a 285 g serving (186 kcal / 100 g), and The Cinnamon Jar chicken bunny at ~270 kcal a quarter. Our serving is about 600 g (~150 kcal / 100 g), so the per-gram figure agrees with FatSecret. Ours is far above both because a real quarter loaf is 175 g of bread before any curry goes in.
